svg.title: Drive Therapy | Vector Brand Style Sheet v1.0
svg.desc: Editable identity guide with full-color, grayscale, one-ink black and reverse-white logos; the actual emblem uses separate vector contour and gradient facet paths. Palette, typography, spacing, minimum sizes and usage rules.

svg.text: D R I V E T H E R A P Y / V I S U A L I D E N T I T Y
Logo system · Color and type · Icon specifications · Brand-use rules
GOLD WORDMARK + FACETED CLOUD / LEAF EMBLEM
EVERY FACET REMAINS A SEPARATE VECTOR PATH
TEXT + ICON STAY TOGETHER AT APPROVED PROPORTIONS
COLORS ARE ASSIGNED BY SHAPE / FACET
Noto Sans ExtraBold • Outlined in delivery SVGs
not as a substitute for Latin brand lettering.
Full-color icon ≥ 48 CSS px; mono ≥ 24 px.
Full lockup ≥ 240 CSS px; print ≥ 30 mm.
Gold text on dark grounds; navy on light.
Never stretch, rotate, recolor facets or flatten.
DRIVE THERAPY / VECTOR IDENTITY • PROPOSED GUIDELINES
Artwork preserved as separate paths; no embedded raster
